fields.summary: Add bulk archive endpoint for work orders
fields.description:
## Requirements

- Add a POST endpoint at `/api/v1/work-orders/bulk-archive` that accepts a list of work order IDs
- Validate that all IDs belong to the requesting tenant
- Only archive work orders in `completed` or `cancelled` status; return errors for any that aren't
- Return a summary response: `{"archived": [...ids], "failed": [{"id": ..., "reason": ...}]}`
- Add an audit log entry for each successfully archived work order
- Limit batch size to 100 IDs per request
